hero: the AI answer card (ChatGPT, 'Is Patty Lane worth a visit?')

seams.id: bank→restaurant (x-ray match cut, scan line sweeps LEFT)
seams.technique: same card, same rect; a vertical scan line wipes right-to-left (the current) from the bank answer into the restaurant answer
cut-the-curve LEFT: payoff frame power4.in 300px + linear-ish fade dying at the cut; card enters mid-flight power4.out 300px, ignites at 0.35 opacity; 8px wrapper blur both sides

seams.id: x-ray world → source world (re-host of the same card)
seams.technique: camera at rest after the Z-forward push; world A's card is swapped for world B's pixel-identical copy (same rect, same state)

seams.id: card → source cloud (scale-burst: leaving a world)
seams.technique: Z forward all the way: after the stillness the push resumes (power3.in lunge) and the card shatters past the lens; shards keep growing (z+), the pills release the cloud
